property_summary: For any caller that is not the keeper, executeBatchDeposit must fail to take effect: dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance must keep its pre-call value; the mutant removes the keeper gate, so a non-keeper call succeeds and zeroes dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance.
change_summary: Delete the access-control revert in onlyKeeper so any caller can execute executeBatchDeposit and thereby reset dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance.
